cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'

mechanism: A obtains practical help while claiming the authority to define whether its manner makes B a partner, subordinate or patron.
confusable: Distinguish ordinary requests for equality from A actually directing the helper and ruling on the relationship those actions establish.
comparison: Table carrying negotiates physical independence and joint decisions; complaint writing negotiates ownership and endorsement of words.
seedUse: Use both canonical help seeds critically; S01 supervision should govern the interpretation of assistance, not appear as a prefixed claim before a plea for equal status.
